findings.title: Concurrency test can pass or hang without observing the race
findings.body: createMultiDeleteMultiReadMulti starts a non-daemon reader thread and then asserts caughtExceptions is empty without joining that thread (or setting a timeout). deletedAll is set true as soon as the deletes return, so the assertion can run while a groups() call is still in flight and record its exception only after the assert, or the reader may not have overlapped the deletes at all. The test can therefore pass even when the concurrent list still returns 500. If any remove() throws before deletedAll.set(true), the reader stays in while (!deletedAll.get()) forever and, because the thread is not a daemon and is never interrupted, it can hang the suite and keep calling the shared admin client during later tests. The flag needs to be set in a finally, the reader joined with a timeout before the assertion, and the test should fail if the reader never actually ran during the deletes.

findings.title: Same null delegate still NPEs on paginated subgroup reads
findings.body: getSubGroupsCount now treats a missing persistence delegate as null, which is the concurrent-delete case this change is fixing. The three paginated overloads immediately below still do modelSupplier.get().getSubGroupsStream(...) with no null check (lines 256, 262, and 268). modelSupplier is the same LazyModel over getGroupModel(), so when the group has been removed it returns null and those calls throw NullPointerException. Any admin or session path that lists children with search or paging while the group is deleted still fails with 500, which is the same failure mode left unfixed.
